verdict.rationale: Capacities' export docs describe a full export where properties become front matter and collections become CSV files. The docs call the output human- and machine-readable and support scheduled automated full exports, which together give researchers an open-format archive independent of the vendor. missing for 10: explicit statement that note bodies export as Markdown, any JSON export format, documentation of the export schema, independent or hands-on corroboration of export fidelity.
